items.item: The page has a breadcrumb or back link to the leave list, a title such as "New leave request", and a single-column form with a visible label above every field and no placeholder-only labels
items.evidence:
Breadcrumb is plain text, not a link:
Time off / New request
, so there is no way back to the leave list. h1 is "Request leave". Every field has a visible label above it and Reason's placeholder is not its only label, but Start date and End date sit side by side (grid sm:grid-cols-2), so the form is not single-column.

items.item: Required fields are marked consistently, and optional ones (such as the attachment) are labelled as optional
items.evidence: Leave type, Start date, End date and Approver each carry a red '*'. Reason and Supporting document carry '(optional)'. #doc-req flips to '(required)' when a document is needed. There is no legend explaining the asterisk, and the '(optional)' text fails contrast at 2.56:1 in the audit.

items.item: Leave type, start date, end date, approver and reason are present; the approver defaults to the employee's manager and can be changed
items.evidence: All five fields exist (#type, #start, #end, #approver, #reason). The approver select starts at '<option value="">Select an approver</option>' and nothing preselects Minh Nguyen, the Engineering Manager. The screenshot shows 'Select an approver'.

items.item: Start and end dates each allow a full day, morning half or afternoon half, and a single-day request can be set as a half day
items.evidence: There is only one checkbox, #half 'Half day (only for single-day requests)', and it is disabled unless start equals end. Neither date has a full day / morning / afternoon option, and a half day cannot be chosen as morning or afternoon.

items.item: The remaining leave balance for the chosen type is visible beside the form and updates with the selection, and the requested duration in days (such as 1.5) is calculated and shown live
items.evidence: The aside 'Summary' has #s-days, #s-bal ('Balance now') and #s-after ('Balance after'). refresh() runs on change of type, start, end and half. days() skips weekends and the HOLIDAYS list and returns 0.5 for a single half day. Half-day amounts like 1.5 cannot be reached because half days are single-day only.

items.item: A request that exceeds the balance, or has an end date before the start date, shows an inline error tied to the field with `aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby`, and the entered input is kept
items.evidence:
validate() shows 'End date cannot be before the start date.' and 'Requested days exceed your N-day balance.' in #end-err, and the input values are kept. err() only toggles the 'border-red-500' class and hides or shows the

. There is no aria-invalid anywhere in the page. Only #type has aria-describedby; #start, #end, #approver and #file do not.

items.item: The attachment control states accepted file types and size limit, lists the chosen file with a remove button, and is keyboard operable
items.evidence: The drop label says 'PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB'. #file-info shows the file name and size with a <button id="file-remove">Remove</button>. #file is a real file input (sr-only) wrapped by a <label for="file">, so it can be focused and opened by keyboard. No visible focus style is shown on the drop zone. Type and size errors appear in #file-err.

items.item: The submit action is a verb label ("Submit request") with a secondary Cancel, shows a busy state while submitting to prevent a double submit, and confirms success with a status message that is announced to assistive technology
items.evidence: The button reads 'Submit request' and Cancel is the outlined secondary. On submit, btn.disabled=true and the text becomes 'Submitting...'. Success writes to #success, which has role="status" and holds the reference, dates and approver. #success starts as display:none (the 'hidden' class), so some screen readers may miss the first announcement.

items.item: Leaving the page with unsaved input triggers a warning, and an option to save as draft is offered
items.evidence: There is no beforeunload handler and no dirty-state tracking. There is no Save draft control. Cancel only calls confirm('Discard this request?').

notes: Clean, restrained Tailwind form, so none of the listed template tells apply. There are no gradients, glass, emoji, KPI tiles, greeting header, sidebar, hover-lift or decorative chart. The 'LT' avatar is a real person (Linh Tran). The 'N' logo tile is indigo-600, but the page has no navy sidebar. The Approved and Pending pills use only two colours. Audit score 90, with only text-contrast failures on the '(optional)' spans (2.56:1). Main failures are the non-link breadcrumb, no manager default for approver, no morning/afternoon half-day choice, no aria-invalid or aria-describedby on most fields, and no unsaved-changes warning or draft saving. Reason is optional, which the checklist does not forbid.
